title: TrueNAS · API Exporter
description: Complete Rust exporter telemetry with independent pool, system and realtime freshness. Measurements are omitted after TTL expiry. ARC hit ratios retain unresolved upstream semantics.

panels.title: Prometheus scrape
panels.description: Current instant sample. Missing data remains Not collected. Collector success includes freshness and latest-attempt outcome.

panels.title: API connection
panels.description: Current instant sample. Missing data remains Not collected. Collector success includes freshness and latest-attempt outcome.

panels.title: Version compatibility
panels.description: Current instant sample. Missing data remains Not collected. Collector success includes freshness and latest-attempt outcome.

panels.title: Realtime subscription
panels.description: Current instant sample. Missing data remains Not collected. Collector success includes freshness and latest-attempt outcome.

panels.title: Data source mode
panels.description: Current instant sample. Missing data remains Not collected. Collector success includes freshness and latest-attempt outcome.

panels.title: Required collectors
panels.description: Current instant sample. Missing data remains Not collected. Collector success includes freshness and latest-attempt outcome.

panels.title: System identity
panels.description: Fresh system.info identity and TrueNAS version. Optional system collection must be enabled.

panels.title: System uptime
panels.description: Cached TrueNAS uptime; no extrapolation between polls.

panels.title: CPU utilization
panels.description: Source percent divided by 100. cpu is aggregate; cpuN is a logical core.

panels.title: Load averages
panels.description: Load counts over 1, 5 and 15 minutes.

panels.title: Physical memory
panels.description: Kernel physical total and available bytes from their verified sources. ARC free/available are separate upstream concepts.

panels.title: Physical memory utilization
panels.description: Derived 1 - available/total. This value alone does not diagnose memory pressure.

panels.title: Source-reported ARC hit ratios
panels.description: Upstream percentages divided by 100. Public history and events have returned zero alongside positive hit rates. Raw nullness and installed algorithm semantics remain unresolved; use as source-reported values.

panels.title: Pool condition
panels.description: Separate bounded status and status_code. FEAT_DISABLED indicates disabled features.

panels.title: Pool warning
panels.description: Independent TrueNAS warning flag; healthy and warning may both be true.

panels.title: Reported scan state
panels.description: Current or retained SCRUB/RESILVER operation. No scan is absence.

panels.title: Reported scan progress
panels.description: Reported percentage /100, including terminal states. FINISHED is not forced to 100%.

panels.title: Reported scan errors
panels.description: Gauge for the current or last reported scan; not a lifetime counter. Missing scan errors remain absent.

panels.title: Link state
panels.description: Source UP/DOWN. Upstream missing-data defaults can already appear as DOWN.

panels.title: Negotiated link speed
panels.description: Event Mbps converted to bits/s. Unknown/down speed is omitted.

panels.title: Receive traffic
panels.description: Instantaneous bytes/s gauge; no rate() applied.

panels.title: Transmit traffic
panels.description: Positive instantaneous bytes/s gauge; no rate() applied.

panels.title: Collector success
panels.description: Latest attempt succeeded and cached snapshot remains fresh. A failed attempt can coexist with retained valid data during its finite TTL.

panels.title: Snapshot age
panels.description: Monotonic age. Missing before first valid sample. Expired measurements disappear while age and history remain.

panels.title: Collection errors by reason
panels.description: Counters by collector and bounded reason. A single realtime lifecycle fault can increment multiple groups.

panels.title: Polling connection errors
panels.description: Polling-client connection error counters; realtime lifecycle errors appear in collector errors. This family is absent until the first polling connection error.
